title: Rapid extraction of total lipids from microalgae
author: Yingyu Hu
materials: Flash freeze filters and stored at -80 °C
Latex bulbs are required for Pasteur pipets
Directly weigh 0.44 g KCl in the bottle. Potassium chloride Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P3911-500G
Dispense 2.0 mL Folch solvent into sample tube.

Use a new pasteur pipet to transfer the lower organic phase to a clear 12 mL storage vial. Do not disturb the cell debris in between the two phases. Clear vial helps to check if there is water drops or impurities in lipids extract after dried. Glass Vials PTFE/SILiCone SEPTA Clear (16 mL, Thermo Scientific, B7990-4) Screw Vial Convenience Kit, 12mL solid top PTFE cap (Thermo Scientific, B7800-12A)
Top bottle with MilliQ water to 50 g

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary tools and solvents to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Rinse forceps (blunt end, stainless steel, Millipore, XX6200006P) with 95% ethanol and air-dry; do not wipe-dry to avoid carbon contamination.
Precombust centrifuge tubes at 500 °C for 06:00:00.
Precombust pasteur pipets (Disposable Soda-Lime Glass, 5 3/4", Fisherbrand, 13-678-6A) at 500 °C for 02:00:00.
Rinse caps with 95% ethanol and air-dry.

Prepare Folch solvent by mixing two parts chloroform (HPLC grade, Merck MilliporeSigma #439142-4L) and one part methanol (Merck MilliporeSigma #34860) in a 1 L amber bottle; log volumes for ratio verification.
Attach a bottle-top dispenser (BrandTech Dispensette® S, 4731330) to the bottle, mix well, and label with MSDS label.
Prepare KCl solution (0.88%).
Weigh and tare a PYREX® Media Bottle (Corning®, 1395-100).

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preparation
steps.instruction: Filter microalgae and prepare samples for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Filter microalgae in liquid media onto precombusted GFF filters using gentle vacuum pressure (130 mm Hg).
Rinse the sample with filtered seawater.
Place sample filters in cryogenic vials.
Filter blank media (without cells) through a precombusted GFF filter as a blank.
Freeze dry samples using a FreeZone® 2.5 L Benchtop Freeze Dryer (Labconco®, 700202000).

If samples are not processed for carbohydrate, transfer freeze-dried samples and blanks into muffled centrifuge tubes (Disposable Glass Screw-Cap, 10 mL, Corning®, 99502-10) with Polypropylene Screw Caps (Linerless, 15-415, Kimble Chase, 73805-15415).

steps.title: Initial Solvent Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract lipids from the sample using Folch solvent.

substeps.instruction: Remove vials from freezer.
Add 100 µL MilliQ water directly onto the sample.
Purge the dispensette and fill tubing with solvent before dispensing into the sample tube.
Vortex for 00:28:00 using a tube insert (VWR ANALOG VORTEX MIXER, 10153-838).
Sonicate for 00:02:00.
Vortex for 00:30:00 using a tube insert.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the organic lipid layer and perform repeated extractions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a set of precombusted tubes (#T1), label them, and place one pasteur pipet (9 inch, VWR, 14672-380) into each.
Prepare another set of precombusted tubes (#T2) for extract and cap them to avoid contamination.
Centrifuge at 3200 rpm at room temperature for 5 minutes (IEC CENTRA CL2, Thermo, 00427 0F).

Use the pasteur pipet to transfer the organic layer to tube #T2. If debris precipitate at the bottom, gently blow air bubbles through the pipet to relocate it to the water layer; avoid transferring water layer and debris into #T2.
Add 1 mL Folch solvent to the residue, vortex with a tube insert for 00:10:00, sonicate for 00:02:00, and centrifuge at 3200 rpm for 5 minutes.
Transfer the organic layer to #T2 using the pasteur pipet.
Repeat the extraction (add 1 mL Folch solvent, sonicate 00:02:00, vortex 00:10:00, centrifuge 3200 rpm for 5 min, and transfer organic layer to #T2) as needed.

steps.title: Purification and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the organic phase and remove solvents.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL KCl solution (0.88%) to tube #T2 (maintaining a Folch solvent to KCl ratio of approximately 4:1), vortex, and centrifuge at 3200 rpm for 5 minutes.
Set heat block (LSE digital dry bath heater, Corning, 6885-DB) to 37 °C and monitor with a thermometer.
Place tubes (#T2) in the heater.
Dry the organic phase extract at 37 °C under a stream of N2 gas (<2 psi) for approximately 00:30:00 using a Reacti-Vap Evaporator (Thermo Scientific, TS-18825).

steps.title: Final Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Redissolve and store the final lipid extract.

substeps.instruction: If water residue or water-soluble impurities remain, redissolve the extract with 5 mL chloroform using a glass serological pipet (Safetypette, Jencons, 75856-442).
Transfer a specific amount of chloroform-dissolved extract (estimated 20 to 100 ug) into a new vial and log the actual volume transferred.
Dry the extract at 37 °C under a stream of N2 gas (<2 psi), generally at a rate of 2 mL/5 min.
Store the dried extract and any excess extract (in chloroform) at -80 °C.
